people.name: Ekai Kawaguchi (河口慧海, Kawaguchi Ekai)

relations.subject: Ekai Kawaguchi (河口慧海, Kawaguchi Ekai)
relations.object: Zen Gohyaku rakan Monastery (五百羅漢寺, Gohyaku-rakan-ji)
relations.evidence: Until March, 1891, he worked as the Rector of the Zen Gohyaku rakan Monastery (五百羅漢寺, Gohyaku-rakan-ji) in Tokyo

relations.subject: Ekai Kawaguchi (河口慧海, Kawaguchi Ekai)
relations.evidence: He assisted the German Theravada monk Nyanatiloka in the 1920s.

relations.subject: Ekai Kawaguchi (河口慧海, Kawaguchi Ekai)
relations.evidence: He was a friend of Mrs. Annie Besant, the president of the Theosophical Society, who encouraged him to publish the English text of his book Three Years in Tibet.

relations.subject: Ekai Kawaguchi (河口慧海, Kawaguchi Ekai)
relations.evidence: near the gate of the Obaku-san Manpukuji Zen Buddhist temple on the outskirts of Kyoto, where he had studied as a young man.
